crossRefs.note: Solomon was told that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath, and had come again.

people.name: Gath
people.line: Philistine city; home of Goliath; refuge for David

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

people.name: Shimei
people.line: Benjamite who cursed David during Absalom's rebellion.

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: Solomon was told that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath, and had come again.
translations.bsb: When Solomon was told that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath and had returned,
translations.kjv: And it was told Solomon that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath, and was come again.
translations.asv: And it was told Solomon that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath, and was come again.
